briefdescription.para: Performance benchmarks for the prompt engineering module.

detaileddescription.para:
Measures:
PromptManager::createTemplate – in-memory insert throughput
PromptManager::getTemplate – in-memory lookup latency (hit / miss)
PromptManager::injectContext – variable substitution throughput
PromptManager::validateTemplate – validation latency (valid / invalid)
PromptVersionControl::commit – version commit throughput
PromptVersionControl::getHistory – history retrieval (10 versions)
FeedbackCollector::recordFeedback – recording throughput
FeedbackCollector::getStats – aggregate stats latency
PromptOptimizer::optimize – single-iteration loop latency

PromptEvaluator::evaluateSingle – structural evaluation latency
PromptEngineeringMetrics (record*) – metrics recording throughput
PromptManager concurrent writes – 4-thread TBB concurrent_hash_map insert
PromptVersionControl concurrent commits – 4-thread concurrent commit throughput

Performance targets (from src/prompt_engineering/ROADMAP.md):
createTemplate (in-memory): < 10 µs
getTemplate (in-memory): < 1 µs
injectContext (5 vars): < 5 µs
validateTemplate (valid): < 5 µs
commit (in-memory): < 20 µs
recordFeedback (in-memory): < 10 µs
optimize (1 iter): < 500 µs
evaluatePrompt (structural): < 50 µs
Build: cmake -DTHEMIS_BUILD_BENCHMARKS=ON ... && cmake build . target bench_prompt_engineering Run: ./benchmarks/bench_prompt_engineering benchmark_format=json
